description.value: A multimodal MRI study examining emotion regulation and associated functional and structural brain abnormalities in adult women with obesity and female healthy controls.

spans.text: Our study aimed to compare the voluntary downregulation of negative emotions by means of cognitive reappraisal in adult women with obesity (OB) and female healthy controls (HC) using a data-driven, multimodal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) approach.

description.value: The present study was carried out in accordance with the latest version of the Declaration of Helsinki.

description.value: A modified cognitive reappraisal task presenting neutral or negative picture stimuli under Observe, Maintain, and Regulate instructions.

spans.text: The task consists of presenting a series of blocks displaying neutral or negative picture stimuli that participants were instructed to (1) “Observe” (to passively observe neutral images); (2) “Maintain” (to actively sustain the negative emotions elicited by the images); or (3) “Regulate” (to reappraise and reduce the intensity of negative emotions by means of previously trained cognitive reappraisal techniques).
